# config.txt -- Pi-boot STAND-IN served by the SAM netboot server (i95b-b1).
# Not a real Raspberry Pi config: the emulation gate serves this file over
# TFTP from a Trinity SD record and byte-compares every DATA block against
# the Go authority. Content is arbitrary but fixed.

arm_64bit=1
enable_uart=1
uart_2ndstage=1
kernel=kernel8.img
